title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Salts Blackcurrant Berry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant Berry from the Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection by Doozy Vape Co delivers a rich, multi-layered berry experience. This succulent blend combines the deep, dark sweetness of juicy Blackcurrants with the tart bite of Blackberries. A carefully selected mix of sweet Red Berries rounds out the profile, creating a balanced and intensely fruity blend that performs consistently throughout the day. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Seriously Pod Fill Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection translates the vibrant flavours of disposable-style profiles into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers everything from juicy fruits to sweet dessert treats. Beyond Blackcurrant Berry, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the chilled Blue Pear Ice or the creamy Caramel Coffee.
